description: Keyword search over all Swissyphus tools this server exposes (with the 'discovery' preset: every module, loaded or not). Returns tool names, what they do, and whether they are loaded. Use describe_tool for the argument schema and call_tool to invoke a tool that is not loaded. Example: 'avalanche danger', 'company VAT', 'train delays', 'court decision'.
name: find_tools
title: Find the right Swissyphus tool
